'
# ============================================================
# HEATMAP 2 – SPEARMAN CORRELATION
# COMPACT LAYOUT | RED-PINK GRADIENT
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. COLORS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
INK = ''#252525''
BG = ''#FFF7F7''

CMAP_DIV = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    ''rose_red_gradient'',
    [''#FFE4E6'', ''#FDA4AF'', ''#F43F5E'', ''#E11D48'', ''#991B1B''],
    N=256
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CHECK INPUT DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
required_cols = [
    ''TaiSanNganHan'', ''NoNganHan'', ''TongNoPhaiTra'',
    ''TongTaiSan'', ''LoiNhuanRong'', ''LoiNhuanGiuLai'',
    ''VonHoaThiTruong''
]

missing_cols = [c for c in required_cols if c not in dataset.columns]

if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f''Thiếu các cột trong dataset: {missing_cols}'')

df = dataset.copy()

for col in required_cols:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors=''coerce'')

total_assets = df[''TongTaiSan''].replace(0, np.nan)
current_liabilities = df[''NoNganHan''].replace(0, np.nan)
total_liabilities = df[''TongNoPhaiTra''].replace(0, np.nan)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CALCULATE 7 FINANCIAL RATIOS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
df[''Liquidity_Ratio''] = df[''TaiSanNganHan''] / current_liabilities
df[''Leverage_Ratio''] = df[''TongNoPhaiTra''] / total_assets
df[''ROA''] = df[''LoiNhuanRong''] / total_assets
df[''Retained_Earnings_Ratio''] = df[''LoiNhuanGiuLai''] / total_assets
df[''CurrentAssets_Ratio''] = df[''TaiSanNganHan''] / total_assets

market_to_liabilities = df[''VonHoaThiTruong''] / total_liabilities

df[''MarketValue_Liabilities''] = np.where(
    market_to_liabilities > 0,
    np.log10(market_to_liabilities),
    np.nan
)

df[''Log_TotalAssets''] = np.where(
    df[''TongTaiSan''] > 0,
    np.log10(df[''TongTaiSan'']),
    np.nan
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SPEARMAN CORRELATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------
RATIO_COLS = [
    ''Liquidity_Ratio'',
    ''Leverage_Ratio'',
    ''ROA'',
    ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio'',
    ''CurrentAssets_Ratio'',
    ''MarketValue_Liabilities'',
    ''Log_TotalAssets''
]

LABELS = [
    ''Liquidity\nRatio'',
    ''Leverage\nRatio'',
    ''ROA'',
    ''Retained\nEarnings\nRatio'',
    ''Current\nAssets\nRatio'',
    ''Market Value\n/ Liabilities'',
    ''Log Total\nAssets''
]

corr = (
    df[RATIO_COLS]
    .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    .corr(method=''spearman'')
)

corr_values = corr.to_numpy()
n = len(LABELS)

mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_values, dtype=bool))
masked_corr = np.ma.array(corr_values, mask=mask)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. FIGURE – REDUCE OUTER PADDING
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7), dpi=150, facecolor=BG)

# [left, bottom, width, height]
ax = fig.add_axes([0.15, 0.16, 0.60, 0.72])
ax.set_facecolor(BG)

im = ax.imshow(
    masked_corr,
    cmap=CMAP_DIV,
    vmin=-1,
    vmax=1,
    aspect=''equal'',
    interpolation=''nearest''
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. CELL GRID
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-0.5, n, 1), minor=True)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-0.5, n, 1), minor=True)

ax.grid(which=''minor'', color=''white'', linewidth=1.3)
ax.tick_params(which=''minor'', bottom=False, left=False)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. AXIS LABELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(n))
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(n))

ax.set_xticklabels(
    LABELS,
    fontsize=9,
    fontweight=''medium'',
    color=INK,
    rotation=0,
    ha=''center'',
    linespacing=1.0
)

ax.set_yticklabels(
    LABELS,
    fontsize=9,
    fontweight=''medium'',
    color=INK,
    rotation=0,
    va=''center'',
    ha=''right'',
    linespacing=1.0
)

ax.tick_params(axis=''x'', length=0, pad=4)
ax.tick_params(axis=''y'', length=0, pad=4)

ax.set_xlim(-0.5, n - 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(n - 0.5, -0.5)

for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. CORRELATION VALUES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i):
        value = corr_values[i, j]

        if np.isfinite(value):
            rgba = CMAP_DIV((value + 1) / 2)
            luminance = (
                0.299 * rgba[0]
                + 0.587 * rgba[1]
                + 0.114 * rgba[2]
            )

            text_color = ''white'' if luminance < 0.55 else INK

            ax.text(
                j, i,
                f''{value:.2f}'',
                ha=''center'',
                va=''center'',
                fontsize=10,
                fontweight=''bold'',
                color=text_color
            )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. MAIN TITLE – FONT SIZE 20
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fig.suptitle(
    ''Hệ số tương quan 7 chỉ số tài chính'',
    fontsize=21,
    fontweight=''bold'',
    color=INK,
    y=0.97
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. COLORBAR – CLOSER TO HEATMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cax = fig.add_axes([0.87, 0.27, 0.016, 0.50])

cbar = fig.colorbar(im, cax=cax)
cbar.outline.set_visible(False)

cbar.set_label(
    ''Spearman Correlation'',
    fontsize=8,
    fontweight=''medium'',
    color=INK,
    labelpad=4
)

cbar.ax.tick_params(
    labelsize=8,
    length=2,
    pad=2,
    colors=INK
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plt.show()
'
'Hệ số tương quan bảy tỉ số'
'''Segoe UI Bold'', wf_segoe-ui_bold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif'
